## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-8: unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Description

Run the full project test command (`bash tests/run-all.sh`) and confirm all new scratch tests (test-scratch-lib.sh, test-scratch-set.sh, test-scratch-get.sh, test-scratch-clear.sh, test-scratch-show-include.sh) are discovered and pass. Confirm no pre-existing tests regressed. If any new test is not discovered (e.g., test-index mapping missing), add the mapping. This task is a green-bar gate on the full suite — not a place to add new behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: N/A (no format_check command configured)
- [ ] All 5 new scratch test files are discovered by the runner
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -cE 'test-scratch-(lib|set|get|clear|show-include)\.sh' | awk '{ exit ($1 >= 5) ? 0 : 1 }'
- [ ] Full suite is green
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh

## File Impact

(No source files; this task is a green-bar gate.)

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
